notes: Explicit semantic review of eligible exact-word duplicates and clear synonyms. Every sharedWith points directly to a standalone source; no chains, cycles, or pilot aliases. Pilot jogging, hiking, and skiing are reused as sources. Equivalent meanings still require the source artwork to pass recognition review for every linked word. Art depicting an action is kept separate from its equipment, and food servings are kept separate from living animals. Distinct species, subspecies, breeds, sports rules, geographical scope, and specific versus generic subjects are not collapsed merely because their words are similar.
